answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in reef, expire in copper, and lagoon lists each expiry. Someone running 109 aliases therefore needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4217 identities would post 3891 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
